title: Decade Boxes
summary: Boxplots of mission length by decade, on a log scale, with the medians to match.
hints: Boxplots need a category on x: `aes(x = factor(decade), y = hours_mission)` + `geom_boxplot()`.
Add `+ scale_y_log10()` to `p_box` to make `p_log`. For the medians: `group_by(decade) |> summarise(median_hours = median(hours_mission))`.
